# se.hadi — Hadi Moustafa

> Web developer and digital marketer in Lebanon. Websites and systems that bring you customers, built, run and marketed by one person. Services, each matched to a common problem: subscriber billing and collections software for local internet providers and other subscription businesses (generators, water, cable, gyms, schools), replacing Excel and paper; websites small businesses can update themselves; Instagram, Facebook and TikTok ads; social media management; and support & maintenance. Free 20-minute call, fixed price in writing, reply within 24 hours. Contact is WhatsApp-first.

## Services

- [Billing & collections system](https://hadimoustafa.dev/services/billing-system): billing software for internet providers and subscription businesses in Lebanon
- [Websites & web apps](https://hadimoustafa.dev/services/engineering): websites for small businesses, with an admin panel
- [Digital marketing](https://hadimoustafa.dev/services/marketing): Instagram, Facebook and TikTok ads with honest reporting
- [Support & maintenance](https://hadimoustafa.dev/services/support)
- [Social media growth](https://hadimoustafa.dev/services/growth)

## Case studies

- [ISP.NET](https://hadimoustafa.dev/work/isp-net): billing and collections system for a local internet provider; 236 active subscribers, 71% of a month's billing settled, one-tap Arabic WhatsApp reminders, offline collector view
- [Zack Production](https://hadimoustafa.dev/work/zack-production): website + admin panel for a Beirut photography and film studio, built in about three weeks
- [A client in Africa: 821 customer conversations for $66.31](https://hadimoustafa.dev/work/africa-client-campaign): two ad campaigns for a business in Africa, objective messages; campaign A 614 conversations at $0.06 ($36.88), campaign B 207 at $0.14 ($29.43), about $0.08 on average
- [Melhem Auto Service: pennies per result from two Instagram boosts](https://hadimoustafa.dev/work/melhem-auto-service): ads & social media management for an auto parts shop in Abidjan; engagement boost 5,090 engagements and 23,538 reached at under half a cent each, traffic boost 2,904 profile visits and 44,436 reached at under 2 cents each
- [Tech store: 98 Instagram profile visits for $6.83](https://hadimoustafa.dev/work/hadi-tech-store): Meta campaign for a technology store, objective Instagram profile visits; 9,659 people reached, 10,241 impressions, about $0.07 per visit
- [Test campaign: what $68 of ads buys](https://hadimoustafa.dev/work/meta-tiktok-ad-campaign): Meta + TikTok test for a fashion brand in Africa; 218 profile visits at $0.13, 6,092 engagements at about $0.01, 88,701 impressions
- [Milestone: 192,377 people reached in 15 days](https://hadimoustafa.dev/work/reach-milestone): 192,377 accounts reached and 248,309 impressions on Meta over 15 days, from Meta Insights
- [Monday ritual: I plan my week in 5 minutes](https://hadimoustafa.dev/work/monday-ritual): Instagram carousel on weekly planning with Claude, with a comment-to-DM offer for the planning prompt
